description: Tell fanin the run is still working, with a short note. Call it at least every few minutes during long work; a run without a heartbeat counts as stalled.

text.description: what the worker is doing now; one line, at most 400 characters are kept

name: fanin_progress

description: Report this run's result to fanin once the work is done or cannot go on. Each kind needs one field: done_pr a pr number, pushed and committed a branch, issue an issue number, nothing and blocked a text. Report again after a fix round; the newest report counts.

branch.description: branch name; required for pushed and committed

issue_url.description: web address of the issue, absolute http(s)

kind.description: the outcome: done_pr, pushed, committed, issue, nothing or blocked

pr.description: pull request number; required for done_pr

text.description: reason for nothing, the question for blocked, or a note; one line, at most 400 characters are kept

name: fanin_report
